CREATE TABLE `library_item` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`entity_type` text NOT NULL,
	`entity_id` text NOT NULL,
	`origin` text NOT NULL,
	`added_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`hlc` text NOT NULL,
	`deleted` integer NOT NULL,
	`change_seq` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `library_remote_track` (
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`provider` text NOT NULL,
	`recording_id` text NOT NULL,
	`remote_id` text NOT NULL,
	`catalog_id` text,
	`source_id` text,
	`raw_title` text NOT NULL,
	`raw_artist` text,
	`raw_album` text,
	`raw_duration_ms` integer,
	`seen_at` integer NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT `library_remote_track_pk` PRIMARY KEY(`user_id`, `provider`, `recording_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `play_event` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`device_id` text NOT NULL,
	`source_id` text NOT NULL,
	`recording_id` text,
	`started_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`played_ms` integer NOT NULL,
	`completed` integer NOT NULL,
	`context` text NOT NULL,
	`scrobbled` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`change_seq` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `playlist` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`owner_id` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`origin` text,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`hlc` text NOT NULL,
	`deleted` integer NOT NULL,
	`change_seq` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `playlist_entry` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`playlist_id` text NOT NULL,
	`recording_id` text NOT NULL,
	`position` text NOT NULL,
	`added_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`hlc` text NOT NULL,
	`deleted` integer NOT NULL,
	`change_seq` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `recording` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`title` text,
	`artist_credit_id` text,
	`duration_ms` integer,
	`disambiguation` text,
	`artist_name` text,
	`album` text,
	`artwork_url` text,
	`explicit` integer,
	`merged_into_id` text,
	`origin` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
	`policy_version` integer NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `source` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`provider` text NOT NULL,
	`external_id` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`recording_id` text,
	`track_id` text,
	`raw_title` text,
	`raw_artist` text,
	`raw_album` text,
	`raw_duration_ms` integer,
	`availability` text DEFAULT 'available' NOT NULL,
	`checked_at` integer,
	`policy_version` integer NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `source_variant` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`source_id` text NOT NULL,
	`codec` text NOT NULL,
	`container` text NOT NULL,
	`sample_rate` integer,
	`bit_depth` integer,
	`channels` integer,
	`bitrate` integer,
	`lossless` integer NOT NULL,
	`encrypted` integer NOT NULL
);
